description: This file defines an interface 'IQueueAdapterFactory' for creating and managing queue-related components such as adapters, caches, mappers, and failure handlers within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating queue adapters, caches, mappers, and failure handlers within the Orleans streaming system.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and returns a queue adapter.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains the delivery failure handler for a specified queue.
